fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Florida newspapers opposing the Florida Recovery Act aimed at chain stores, alleging coordinated press influence tied to chain-store advertising. Covers Miami municipal election campaigning and candidates, and reports on a federal investigation involving Miami detective chief Eugene I. Bryant and the purported recovery of Biltmore hotel robbery jewels, including allegations of reward-sharing and attempted bribery. Also features a letter urging major employers to protect workers from high-interest small-loan firms, discussion of gambling at the Beach Club (Miami Beach), and promotional/entertainment columns including Kentucky Derby selections and local nightlife items.
